verdicts.reason: A: the decorative shapes are squashed into a cluttered strip that runs right into 'HOHOHO'. The brand name is split across two lines with mismatched type scales, the blue ring is cropped flat, and the right and bottom halves are dead empty. B has the same broken strip of decorations and cropped ring, plus an even bigger gap between 'HOHOHO' and 'AGENCY' that breaks the brand name further apart. The black triangle and ring also crowd the tagline. A's tighter wordmark grouping makes it slightly less bad.
